heading: Dallas USCIS medical exam booking: what changes speed and total cost
i693_document_requirements: Bring ID, USCIS paperwork, vaccine records, and any prior TB or immigration-medical documents that may shorten intake.
vaccination_handling_notes: If vaccines are missing, ask whether the office can solve that same week or whether it becomes a separate outside step.
bilingual_support: If you need bilingual support, ask whether it is available during form review, not just at scheduling.
appointment_booking_notes: A good Dallas office should explain booking, exam, vaccines, labs, and release timing as one process.
Booking flow: verify USCIS designation, ask total cost, confirm documents/vaccine records, schedule exam, complete labs/vaccines, then pick up sealed packet after final review.
